summary: Lixte Biotechnology Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of Nomad Transportable Power Systems, Inc. via a merger on July 1, 2026. Merger Sub merged into NOMAD, leaving NOMAD as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Consideration comprised up to 50,500 Series D Convertible Preferred Shares ($1,000 per share, convertible at $1.00) and up to ~3,000,005 common shares; actual issuance was 50,366.07 preferred and 2,992,041 common. No premium or board recommendation stated. The preferred stock is non-voting pending stockholder approval of conversion. Watch for stockholder vote on conversion and potential dilution management.
